scope: Computational artificial-life research: integer programs on a bounded virtual machine, search operators and simulated populations of software objects. No biological material, organism, procedure or design of any kind.

worlds.A: observable regime word in the ask tick
worlds.B: cue tick, then PUT, then bare ASK
worlds.C: lifetime of 16 trials, block 4, cue reliability .7

no_privileged_signal: no phase variable, mode bit, clock or memory operation; the cue is an ordinary input word
held_out: 4 fresh sets (indices 10000+); a world is CROSSED if the mean held-out reward of the top-4 is >= threshold in >= 2/3 seeds; a control that crosses is a LOOPHOLE (world invalid)
material_rule: always material: the crossing table is the result
